study type: International, multicenter study with a retrospective French cohort and a prospective US cohort
cohort: 264 pregnancies in 204 patients with antiphospholipid syndrome
finding: Antithrombotic therapy with aspirin and/or LMWH during pregnancy in women with antiphospholipid syndrome was not associated with an increased risk of hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Emergency Caesarean section was significantly associated with an increased risk of bleeding.
